summary: Roger Torgler, 60, of Colorado Springs, died after several passengers fell out of a commercial raft entering Boat Eater Rapid just past the Royal Gorge Bridge; pulled from the water unresponsive, CPR and defibrillator applied by guides, pronounced dead at the scene; 12th confirmed water-related death in Colorado in 2023.
location: Boat Eater Rapid, Arkansas River, Royal Gorge
responding_agency: Colorado Parks and Wildlife (Arkansas Headwaters Recreation Area); Fremont County Sheriff's Office
notes: Heart of the Rockies Radio article + CPW release dated June 19, 2023 (both parent-opened); victim named by the Fremont County Coroner per the City Daily Record, June 20, 2023, quoted in the American Whitewater accident record (parent-opened); 'Monday afternoon' = 2023-06-19 (Monday-verified). Run 1019 chunk C.
